# Prism Zero

Light and Dark color themes for [Panic Nova](https://nova.app/), based on [PrismJS](https://prismjs.com/) syntax colors (adjusted for UI chrome and dark backgrounds).


## Screenshots

### Light

![Prism Zero Light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rinodrops/prism-zero/main/screenshots/light-nova.webp)

### Dark

![Prism Zero Dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rinodrops/prism-zero/main/screenshots/dark-nova.webp)

## Themes

- **Prism Zero Light** — light UI with Prism-style syntax colors
- **Prism Zero Dark** — dark UI on `#0c0e13` with the same syntax family

## Install

Install from Nova's Extension Library, then choose **Prism Zero Light** or **Prism Zero Dark** under Themes.

## More of Prism Zero

Prism Zero also provides matching Light and Dark themes for Visual Studio Code, Cursor, Panic Nova, Neovim, Typora, iTerm 2, Prompt 3, Ptyxis, Windows Terminal. Theme files and install notes: [https://github.com/rinodrops/prism-zero](https://github.com/rinodrops/prism-zero).
